detail.longDescription: Adding a stdio MCP server is running a program on the host. In Langflow before 1.9.0, any logged-in user, not just admins, could do it: the command field went to bash -c "exec {command}" unchecked and ran when the server list loaded, and env took LD_PRELOAD. CVE-2026-105740, CVSS 9.9, fixed in 1.9.0. An "add MCP server" form is a shell prompt. Gate it like one. https:// github.com/langflow-ai/langflo w/security/advisories/GHSA-7w94-79vh-5mr2 # Cybersecurity # MCP # AIAgents
